content: MS Learn WIQL syntax (updated 2026-07-23): ASOF clause returns items as they satisfied filters at a past date/time; ISO 8601 with Z is locale-independent; ASOF incompatible with tree (MODE Recursive) link queries; 32K char WIQL limit; Query By Wiql returns IDs only. workitemsbatch accepts asOf for field values at that time (SDK WorkItemBatchGetRequest.AsOf in b5 and v7).
